title: Sustainable Golf Shoes
summary: Learn more about the renewable materials that help make the Allbirds Golf Dashers sustainable golf shoes that deliver unrivaled comfort and performance.
body_markdown:
## Meet the Renewable Materials That Make the Golf Dashers


We’ve reduced the carbon footprint of the Golf Dashers to just 6.88 CO2e while still delivering superior performance and a supremely comfortable fit.


Here’s how we did it:


**ZQ Merino Wool:** Sourced from New Zealand—where sheep outnumber humans about six to one(!)—our[ZQ Merino Wool](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/our-materials-wool) is made using a process that requires 60% less energy than materials used in the average synthetic shoe. Soft, durable, and moisture-wicking, you’ll find this wool combined with recycled polyester in the ripstop of the shoe, as well as the ultra-soft lining inside.


**FSC-Certified Natural Rubber Outsole:** Rooted in responsible forestry practices, the FSC-certified natural rubber outsole not only delivers impeccable traction via grippy, multi-directional lugs but also minimizes environmental impact, helping to preserve our ecosystems in the process.


**Bio-Based TPU Mudguard:** A bio-based TPU mudguard helps keep your feet dry during the wetter days on the course—and also when you encounter any unexpected splashes.


**SweetFoam® Midsole:** Our innovative[SweetFoam® is made from sugarcane](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/our-materials-sugar) sourced from southern Brazil, where it thrives solely on rainwater, eliminating the need for irrigation. This sugarcane is a fully renewable resource, growing rapidly and actively removing carbon from the atmosphere. Plus, our sourcing is guided by stringent measures for both environmental preservation and human well-being—a collaborative effort between Proforest and Braskem—with farming operations subject to independent audits.


**Castor Bean Oil:** Along with eucalyptus tree fiber and our ZQ Merino wool blend, the Golf Dasher’s insoles include castor bean oil-based foam, a highly sustainable and biodegradable material.Own the course with the most comfortable golf shoes that do their part to preserve your favorite greens and fairways.
